name: Panhandle Homes RV Park
skip_reason: Cannot confirm a real inventory of nightly transient sites, and every firsthand description leans long-term - WV's seasonal-park trap. The operator is a mobile-home dealer: 'Panhandle Homes Inc' is listed under Mobile Home Dealers on checkbca and under mobile-home-park on chamberofcommerce (BBB files it under RV Parks). No operator website exists - the only presence is a Facebook page that serves no content to fetch - and there is no booking channel or published nightly rate from the operator anywhere; the $33 is RV Life's own average. The chamber testimonials describe a retired couple using it for 'a 4 month extended visit' and others 'keeping their camper there year-round', not overnight travel. Esri imagery at the Census-matched 175 Viderman Dr (40.24100,-80.65019) shows a large packed yard of mobile-home units on the Ohio River bank plus a separate northern loop of roughly 15-25 spaced trailers, which could be either. Also unresolved: RV Life addresses it to Wellsburg while the Facebook page places it in Beech Bottom, about 4 mi north. NOT disqualified on the merits - if it does rent nightly it would qualify, and it sits directly on the Ohio River - but it cannot be added on this evidence. Phone 304-374-3027 to settle it.
